morphology.pattern_note: 被动前缀 di- 与词根连写，不改变 sedut 的首音；该形式不自行表达过去时。输入将 disedut 视为词根的分析已修正。

senses.zh_definition: 被吸入、吸进或通过抽吸移走，通常涉及空气、烟雾、液体或微粒。
senses.en_definition: To be inhaled, sucked in, or removed by suction.
senses.ms_definition: Ditarik masuk atau dikeluarkan dengan kekuatan udara melalui mulut, hidung atau alat penyedut.
senses.nuances: 这是 sedut 的被动形式，主语通常是被吸入或抽走的物质；不能一概译为表示渗透吸收的 diserap。释义按 [DBP：sedut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sedut) 转为被动表达。

senses.zh_definition: 从文字、讲话等材料中被摘取或节录。
senses.en_definition: To be excerpted or extracted from a text, speech, or similar source.
senses.ms_definition: Dipetik atau diambil daripada tulisan, ucapan atau bahan sumber yang lain.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻用法；一般编辑说明中 dipetik 更直白。依据 [DBP：sedut 的比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sedut)，不是下载文件的通用正式说法。

collocations.en: an excerpt taken from a letter
a section extracted from a report

senses.zh_definition: 钱财等被榨取、抽走或攫取。
senses.en_definition: To be siphoned off or extracted, especially of money.
senses.ms_definition: Diambil atau diperas, khususnya wang, secara kiasan.
senses.nuances: 带负面评价，常暗示剥削或不当获利。依据 [DBP：sedut 的比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sedut)；不宜替代中性的 dibayar 或 dikutip。

collocations.en: the public’s money is drained away

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 设备操作说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Habuk yang terhasil semasa kerja pemotongan disedut melalui sistem pengudaraan khas.
dual_scenarios.zh: 切割过程中产生的灰尘通过专用通风系统被抽走。
dual_scenarios.en: Dust generated during cutting is extracted through a dedicated ventilation system.

dual_scenarios.en: Has the dust under the sofa been vacuumed up yet?

etymology.historical_story: Disedut is formed within Malay from sedut and the passive prefix di-. The same root connects breathing, drinking through a straw, and mechanical suction through a shared inward movement. Dictionary usage also extends that image to extracting passages or draining money. These connections explain its semantic range without requiring an unsupported account of its earliest origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 di-，先想“被”：menyedut 是“吸”，disedut 是“被吸”；想象灰尘被吸进吸尘器。
